title: Command request (orchestrator-only-writes pilot)
description: A command a non-orchestrator agent asks the orchestrator to run. Run by `agentteams --run-request FILE --agent SLUG` only if argv matches that agent's registered prefix and argument patterns.

argv.description: An argument list; never a shell string.

expected_writes.description: Paths the command is expected to change; other changes are reported.

stdin_from_content.description: Content piped to the command after the gates matching path pass on it (e.g. a Lean draft to `lake env lean --stdin`).

agent.description: Optional; must equal the agent the dispatch nonce was issued to, else the artifact is refused.

dispatch.description: The dispatch nonce from `agentteams --issue-dispatch`; the agent is read from its signed record.
